$comment: A BAD discovery call: the prospect deflects and gives vague, non-committal answers. A good classifier should leave most slots empty, and vague answers must NOT be scored 'covered' (economicBuyer stays at most 'partial'). Also seeds the known failure mode where REP speech names budget/EB but the PROSPECT never confirms — those must not advance any slot.
